teamDelModal.alert: Removing the team will remove: resonance buffs, and enemy configs stored in the team. Loadouts that are only in this team are also selected by default for deletion.

alert.desc: Teams are a container for 4 character loadouts. It provides a way for characters to apply team buffs, and configuration of enemy stats. Loadouts can be shared between teams.
alert.first: The first character in the team receives any "active on-field character" buffs, and cannot be empty.

teamSettings.title: Team Members
teamSettings.buffsEmpty: Add a character to see the team's resonance, Moonsign, Hexerei and reaction buffs.
teamSettings.noResonance: No elemental resonance with this lineup.

exportModal.title: Team Export
exportModal.alert: Export the team data to be imported by another user. All the team and loadout data (bonus stats, enemy config, optimize config) are exported. All exported non-TC builds are converted to TC builds.

enemyEditor.announceBtn: To get the specific resistance values of enemies, please visit the wiki.
enemyEditor.note: Note: Genshin Impact halves resistance shred values below 0%. For the sake of calculations enter the RAW value and Stellar Optimizer will do the rest. (e.g. 10% - 20% = -10%)

buildInfo.equipped: This is the build currently equipped to your character, this represents in-game equipment and is persistent outside of the Loadout.
buildInfo.build: A Build is comprised of a weapon and 5 artifacts.
buildInfo.tcbuild: A Theorycraft Build allows defining a build by raw stats.

buildTcCharOverride.tip: Set a specific level, constellation, ascension, or talent level for this TC build, that is different from the base character
buildTcCharOverride.btn: Override Character Data for This TC build

tcNoOptimize.title: This loadout is using a theorycraft build
tcNoOptimize.description: The optimizer and the artifact upgrader search the artifacts you own, so they need a real build. Switch this loadout to its equipped build to use them; your theorycraft build is kept and can be picked again from the build menu above.

teamOpt.desc: Builds for the whole team at once. Every member’s attacks in one rotation count, with the buffs the members give each other, and no artifact is used twice: a support gets the set and stats that help the team most.

editor.buffsHint: Each buff shows what it gives and how much more damage this attack deals with it. Untick one that is not up during this attack, pick another of its states, or limit it to the first hits (e.g. Shenhe’s quills).
editor.hitsHint: Casts or hits in one rotation; averages like 2.5 are fine.
editor.impact: What the buff adds to this attack’s damage
editor.limitHint: Up for the first hits only (e.g. quills). All hits by default.
editor.noBuffs: No conditional buffs are on in this team. Turn them on in Team settings or on each character’s tabs.
editor.onField: On the field during these hits
editor.onFieldHint: Buffs for the active character (e.g. Mitya’s C1) go to whoever is on the field. Pick another member for hits that land while they are, e.g. a skill that keeps hitting after a switch.
editor.stateHint: Its state during this attack. The rotation’s is the one set in Team settings or on the character’s tabs.
editor.extraHint: Bonus stats for this attack only: a buff the game data does not have, or your own numbers. For the whole rotation, use Extra buffs.
editor.impactDetail: One hit: {{with}} with this buff, {{without}} without
editor.neededDetail: The attack deals no damage without it: {{with}} per hit with it
editor.allIdle: None of the team’s buffs changes this attack’s damage.
editor.unusedHint: Passives of weapons and artifact sets the member does not have on now, and effects that are not unlocked. A weapon’s or set’s passive counts once Team Optimize picks it for the member.
editor.critCapped: CRIT Rate is {{value}} without it: already over the 100% cap

empty.desc: Team Optimize finds artifacts for the whole team at once, for one rotation of their attacks.
empty.title: Add the team’s members first

member.tc: TC build: kept as it is
member.noEffectsHint: Set effects count only when on: click to turn them on

pool.title: Inventory
pool.effects: Set effects count only when on (Requirements → Artifact sets)
pool.excludedHelp: This team is never optimized with these. Find one below, or press ⊘ on an artifact in a result.
pool.findHelp: Click an artifact to exclude it; click it again to use it again.

result.buildChanges: The best build, with other artifacts on
result.noChange: The current builds are already the best ones found for this rotation.
result.saveHint: A new build per member, used by this team. Nothing moves between characters.
result.unmetWhy: No build reaches it with this member’s settings: its main stats, the sets it may use, the artifact levels and the weapons ticked. This build gets the closest. Lower the requirement, or allow more.
result.unmetKept: Kept as it is: its build does not reach it.
result.equipWarn_one: Equips the new build on 1 member (a saved build is updated instead). Artifacts move from whoever wears them now.
result.equipWarn_other: Equips the new builds on {{count}} members (saved builds are updated instead). Artifacts move from whoever wears them now.
result.share: Its share of the team’s damage
result.shareDps: Its share of the team’s DPS
result.untickedWeapon: Not ticked: kept, no ticked weapon was free
result.hitsTitle: Damage per hit, in the rotation
result.stale: Found with an earlier rotation or settings: what changed since is not in it.
result.belowNowSets_one: can’t keep their current build: it breaks their allowed sets (Requirements → Artifact sets)
result.belowNowSets_other: can’t keep their current builds: they break their allowed sets (Requirements → Artifact sets)
result.belowNowWeapons_one: can’t keep their current weapon: it isn’t ticked in Weapons to choose from
result.belowNowWeapons_other: can’t keep their current weapons: they aren’t ticked in Weapons to choose from
result.excludedToast: Excluded from this team. Run again to find builds without it.

rotation.empty: No attacks yet. A support without attacks still counts through the buffs it gives.
rotation.info: Add each member’s attacks and how often they hit in one rotation. The buffs are the ones that are on in Team settings and on the characters’ tabs: open an attack to turn off one that is not up during it, to put it in another state, or to limit one to its first hits (Shenhe’s quills, a buff that runs out).
rotation.title: Rotation

run.allKept: Every member’s build is kept: nothing to optimize.
run.buildsInfo: How many team builds to find: the best one, then the next best ones (each changes one member’s artifacts).
run.how: Each member is optimized in turn for the whole rotation’s damage, the others fixed, the biggest damage dealer first. Rounds repeat until no build changes; then members trade pieces and weapons where the team gains.
run.setRulesUnmet: No team build fits the allowed sets of
run.setRulesUnmetWhy: Even with the pieces the other members hold, no build of the artifacts they may use keeps to the sets allowed on their Optimize tab (Requirements → Artifact sets), with their main stats and the inventory settings. Allow more sets, or free up pieces of the sets they need.

teamOpt.title: Team optimize

weapons.title: Weapons to choose from
weapons.desc: Each member tries the ticked weapons of its type, along with its artifacts. A passive counts only when it is on for that character. An energy weapon in the team lowers each member’s Energy Recharge requirement by what you set for that member: click ⚡ on it.
weapons.passiveHint: Saved on each character’s loadout: its pages use the same settings.
weapons.energyHint: Gives energy or particles: click to set how much less Energy Recharge each member needs with it in the team.
weapons.energySetHint: Less Energy Recharge each member needs while someone in the team wields it. Click to change.
weapons.energyAdd: Gives energy? Set how much less Energy Recharge each member needs
weapons.teamEnergyHint: How much less Energy Recharge each member needs while someone in the team wields this weapon.
weapons.noEnergyNeedHint: : no Energy Recharge requirement, so this changes nothing yet
weapons.tooFewTicked: Tick one for each member: a member left without one keeps its current weapon.

onField.label: On field
onField.info: Who is on the field during the rotation’s hits, unless an attack says otherwise (open it to change it). Buffs for the active character, like Mitya’s C1 CRIT DMG, go to them, and the ones for off-field characters to the others. Elsewhere the app counts the team’s first member as on the field.

extra.title: Extra buffs
extra.info: Buffs the game data does not have, like food, an Abyss blessing or your own numbers. For the whole team or one member: they count on its hits and in its stats and requirements.
extra.zero: At 0 it does nothing: enter its value.

transfer.title: Import a team rotation
transfer.desc: Paste a rotation exported from Team optimize. The members in it get its attacks; the others keep theirs.
transfer.label: Rotation JSON
transfer.invalid: This is not a team rotation export.

rotationTime.label: Rotation time
rotationTime.info: How long one rotation takes, for the DPS. Saved for this team.

sens.title: What raises team damage
sens.info: Each cell: the team’s rotation damage with that one change on that member, against the result above (same rotation, buffs, artifacts and weapons). A roll is an average 5★ roll, as in the Improve tab’s Substat value.
sens.readSubstat: How to read it: one extra {{stat}} roll on <name/>’s artifacts raises the team’s damage by {{value}}.
sens.readTalent: How to read it: one more {{talent}} level on <name/> raises the team’s damage by {{value}}.
sens.readLevel: How to read it: <name/> at level {{level}} raises the team’s damage by {{value}}.

kqm.staleShort: Setup changed. Run again to refresh.
kqm.artifactTotalsTip: All five artifacts: main stats + 2 fixed rolls per substat + 20 distributed rolls. Excludes character, weapon and set bonuses. Hover a stat for its breakdown.
kqm.linkedCompareTip: Choose a set to re-rank weapons, or a weapon to re-rank sets. Main stats and substats are optimized again. Teammates keep the builds from this run.
kqm.catchUpTip: Greedy estimate of extra average rolls above the 20-roll KQM budget, with the same equipment, main stats and teammates. Per-stat placement caps and ER requirements still apply. No match means the search could not close the gap within 20 extra rolls.
kqm.catchUpHeader: Each row shows the extra substats needed to match the row immediately above it. Hover the roll estimate to see the stat amounts.
kqm.buttonInfo: Compare weapons and artifact sets using KQM builds at C6 for 4★ characters and C0 for 5★ characters.
kqm.compareInfo: The team’s damage with each set (and the best weapon), and with each weapon (and the best sets), for this member: its main stats and rolls chosen again each time, the others’ builds as they are.
kqm.info: KQM builds use C6 for 4★ characters and C0 for 5★ characters, selected level 90 weapons and five 5★ artifacts at +20. Each build has 2 fixed rolls of every substat and 20 optimized rolls. Your rotation, main stat filters and requirements apply.
kqm.resultInfo: Level 90, C6 for 4★ and C0 for 5★, 10/10/10 base talents plus constellation bonuses. Five +20 artifacts: 2 fixed rolls of each substat and 20 distributed rolls, with at most 2 distributed rolls per eligible piece per stat. Selected equipment, ER targets and team rotation settings apply.
kqm.title: KQM builds
kqm.tooFewTicked: Select at least one weapon of this type before generating builds.
kqm.unmetWhy: No KQM build reaches it with this member’s main stats and allowed sets. This build gets the closest.
kqm.setupIntro: Compare weapons and artifact sets for your rotation using KQM Standards artifacts.
kqm.weaponSummary: Defaults: R5 craftable, event, fishing and 4★ standard wish weapons; R1 Battle Pass and rewards. Event wish, 5★ standard wish and Starglitter weapons start off.
kqm.setSummary: Choose which sets to compare and configure their effects for each member. Each member’s existing set rules still apply.
kqm.refinementHelp: Craftable, event and fishing weapons default to R5; Battle Pass and one-copy rewards to R1. Each weapon’s own refinement setting takes priority.
kqm.noMembers: Select at least one member in Setup.
kqm.missingWeapons: Select at least one weapon for each selected member in Weapons.
kqm.compareHelp: Each row shows the whole team’s damage when this member’s weapon or set changes. Main stats and rolls are optimized again; other members keep the builds shown above. Percentages are relative to the best team build found.
kqm.weaponHelp: Select weapons to compare. Adjust refinement, effects and energy contribution below each weapon.
kqm.noMatches: No matches. Change the search or turn off Selected only.
kqm.setHelp: Choose sets and configure their effects for each member. Their existing set rules still apply. Clear all to compare without a set bonus.
kqm.noSets: No artifact sets selected. Builds will have no set bonus.

calc.active: Calculator targets applied. ER is recalculated for each weapon choice during optimization. Editing a target switches back to manual ER requirements.
calc.title: Calculate the team’s ER needs
calc.intro: Confirm skill uses, particle catching and field time for one rotation. ER is calculated for the whole team, then applied to KQM. Extra energy from abilities or effects goes in Bonus flat energy.
calc.globalHelp: Enemy clear particles are the total neutral particles dropped over the chamber clear time. Electro resonance particles require two Electro teammates; their interval is at least 5 seconds.
calc.memberHelp: Set rotations per burst to 0 if the burst is unused. Turret particles are distributed by field time. Confirm any energy refunds from character passives in Bonus flat energy.
calc.advanced: Secondary skill, Favonius and bonus energy
calc.weaponHelp: The preview counts Favonius and flat-energy weapon triggers for members who may use such a weapon here. During optimization they follow each build’s weapon and refinement. Supported flat-energy weapons: Amenoma, Kitain, Katsuragikiri, Prototype Amber and Everlasting Moonglow. For other effects, include only bonus energy that applies to every build you compare. ER reductions entered in the Weapons window are not applied again.
calc.breakdown: {{particles}} particle energy at 100% ER + {{flat}} flat energy per rotation; burst cost {{cost}}.
calc.flatTip: Energy per rotation from character abilities or effects shared by every build.

kqm.erHelp: Total ER% each member needs, or calculate it for this rotation. 100% (the default) means no extra ER. The optimizer meets ER first, then uses the remaining rolls for damage.
kqm.erAllocate: Rolls allocated to meet this target
kqm.standardTip: KQM Standards: 2 fixed rolls of every substat + 20 distributed rolls. Base talents are 10/10/10, with constellation bonuses. Enemy and rotation settings follow this team.
